display_long_description:
# A Case Lost in Time 
Step into the role of a detective and investigate the mysterious disappearance of your colleague in this story-driven puzzle adventure. Every decision you make brings you closer to the truth... or further from it. Do you have what it takes to crack the case? 

You will need to solve tricky puzzles,
[media]
break into secret hideouts,
[media]
and travel through time
[media]
to find out the truth and to finish the mission.


# Discover the real history behind ancient gold treasures
The game is inspired by the oldest known gold treasure in the world, found in the Varna Necropolis, and features historical facts that you uncover during your playthrough as part of the story.


# After completing the main adventure you unlock "SpeedRun Mode" 
A dedicated challenge for competitive players. Replay the game, optimize every movement and puzzle solution, and refine your strategy to perfection. With lap times and global leaderboards you can compete with your friends and players around the world in multiple categories.
